value.rationale: Involutions are a canonical inverse-symmetric subclass of strict rankings; pairwise comparisons are the natural binary observations. The exact adaptive saturation through ten letters is not entailed by total involution counts or the known static forest bound. The ten-letter example yields a quantitative unbounded VC-Littlestone gap for this restricted family via a reusable direct-sum construction, making the precise finite certificate mathematically consequential.
